description:
Make `jit validate <id> --rule <rule>` compute the one report from the records the capture parsed and call `ValidationReport::select(&Selection::Rule { .. })` on it directly, deleting `validate_rule`.

## Background

- `validate_rule` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1959-1970`) captures the validation image and calls `rule_validation_outcome` (`:1114-1174`), which parses issues and declarations again (`:1120-1126`), assembles configuration a second time (`:1127`) and evaluates the rule with the issue as its sole firing subject. A missing, off, non-graph or non-matching rule is a `RuleSelectionFault` (`:1177-1201`, from `validation::graph::select_graph_rule`), which the view renders as one error finding (`:1969`). An unloadable rule set propagates as an error (`declarations_from_image(image)?`, `:1126`).
- `rule_validation_outcome` also serves the rule-validation gate checker, which keeps calling it and records a `RuleSelectionFault` as an `error` run.
- The validation capture holds no event-log history and no gate-run listing; only whole-repository validation and the repository-validation gate checker read those.
- Tests: `crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/scope_validation_tests.rs:285-468` (rule validation through the executor) and `tests/cli_item_validate/validate_cli_rule_tests.rs:666-808` (CLI output).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit validate <id> --rule <rule>` calls `ValidationReport::select` for the issue and rule directly on the report computed from one validation capture whose parsed records the report reads; no per-view wrapper remains (`validate_rule` is deleted), and the view reads no event-log history and no gate-run listing.
- [hard] REQ-02: A rule selection fault reports the same error finding as before, and the CLI rule tests pass unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: A harness test with an unloadable rule set shows that the rule view reports the `rules-file` finding; it fails on today's code, which returns an error.
- [hard] REQ-04: The executor-level rule tests in `scope_validation_tests.rs` are reduced to wiring or removed where the selection tests own the property.

## Decisions

- **D-01** — Steward ruling 2026-11-04: the CLI and the checkers call the one `ValidationReport::select(&Selection)` entry point (and `ValidationReport::explain`) directly, with no per-view wrapper function; the issue, rule and scope views share one executor function that captures once and computes the report without history, which 2c8c13b2 introduces and 86f7e6eb and 208edf4c reuse. Rejected: per-view wrappers (`run_rules`, `explain_rules`, `validate_scope`, `validate_rule`), four thin copies around one selection.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: with an unloadable rule set the rule view reports the `rules-file` finding where it returned a load error.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Single-rule validation selects from the report
